featured_reviews.name: Rohit Shenoy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience and extremely poor management.

We had booked an appointment weeks in advance for my 70+ year-old mother, who was accompanied by my 55+ year-old mother-in-law for today (March 16, 2026). Despite the appointment, they were made to wait for over three hours. To make matters worse, they were never seen by Abhijeet Desai, the doctor the appointment was booked with. Instead, they were seen by an intern/assistant who immediately pushed for an eye test without clearly explaining the issue or next steps.
We were charged AED 800 for consultation, even though the main doctor never saw them, and another AED 2,000 for an eye test, yet there was still no clear direction after the reports. There is also no proper token or queue system. Patients are simply called by name, which defeats the whole point of booking appointments.
The most shocking part was being told to come “with a full stomach” next time because the waiting time for the retinal specialist could be even longer. Telling elderly patients to prepare for hours of waiting instead of managing appointments properly shows a serious lack of empathy.

Being a doctor does not give anyone the right to disrespect patients’ time. Very unprofessional experience.
